dogecoin.text:
And the unholy trio of #Tiktok-esque hype + amateur daytraders on leveraged longs + professional daytraders on short resulted in a gigantic series of liquidations.

Also, who can forget the $DOGE clone invasion of #Ethereum #ERC20? And #VitalikButerin's classy move https://t.co/jz8FtsHOn2

Meanwhile, $ETH and #Dapps were beginning their period of exponential growth. Many people buying into $DOGE also discovered #Binance. 

And @binance who had beeb building #BinanceSmartChain saw an opportunity to gain users. @PancakeSwap started seeing new people in droves.

Enter @elonmusk. 

Right as $GME euphoria reached its peak, BTC and ETH was also having its own rally.

There were already hundreds of thousands of people who missed the pump, and were hungry for the next one.

$DOGE took off along with $BTC for a wild, wild ride.

I feel the "Elon controls markets" narrative has some merit. But it definitely is not the only cause.

And I'll tell you why I think so in this thread about #cryptocurrencies, #DeFi, and $BTC, $ETH, $DOGE, and $GME
